scope: Bounded job selection and analysis; no application drafting, filling or submission.

policy.candidateContext: Reuse N01 candidate resume and onboarding context; do not replay onboarding in fresh sessions.

evidenceDelivery.lookout: Identical released email and job evidence with identical task request.
evidenceDelivery.baseline: Identical released email and job evidence with identical task request.

policy.effort: Unique observed interaction turns are primary; category counts overlap and must not be summed. Prescribed initiations separate. Both conditions receive the same prescribed initiations; proactive effort savings are not measured.

stages.baseline: Review this job email and save suitable target jobs with evidence-grounded fit analyses using my current preferences.

email.subject: New graduate job opportunities
email.body: Please review the attached frozen job listings.

stages.request: Platform engineering is now my primary focus. Keep inference infrastructure secondary.
Keep analyses concise. For the top three, lead with technical fit and name one material gap. Put remaining recommendations on one line each. Avoid promotional language.

stages.baseline: Review this job email and save a complete updated shortlist with evidence-grounded fit analyses using my current preferences.

email.subject: New graduate job opportunities
email.body: Please review the attached frozen job listings and prepare a complete updated shortlist, not only newly added jobs.

qualityRubric.analysis_accuracy: Claims and material gaps are grounded in released evidence and candidate facts; uncertain eligibility remains uncertain.
qualityRubric.initial_preferences_applied: Initial shortlist follows onboarding career preferences, without anticipating the later platform-first update.
qualityRubric.initial_style_adherence: Initial analyses follow onboarding presentation preferences; the later top-three format is not expected yet.
qualityRubric.career_preference_saved: Confirmed platform-primary/inference-secondary preference is accurately retained without unrelated changes.
qualityRubric.style_preference_saved: The user correction is retained after it is delivered.
qualityRubric.preferences_applied: Complete updated shortlist reflects the confirmed current preferences.
qualityRubric.style_adherence: Later analyses follow the corrected top-three concise format.
qualityRubric.selection_suitability: Judge all returned jobs, including extras: suitable extras are acceptable; unsupported, ineligible or off-preference extras reduce quality. Exact target recall remains separate.
qualityRubric.continuity: Fresh-session work uses retained context and returns the complete current shortlist, not just new additions.
qualityRubric.saved_work: Complete shortlist and analysis are durably saved in owned records or persistent files. Chat-only output is insufficient. Accept equivalent native record/file layouts; do not demand a particular storage field.
